name: Pro Faceted Filter Bar
description: Linear/Notion-style filter bar: typed chips with operator and value popovers, typeahead across fields and values, live facet counts, URL-synced state (nuqs), saved views, clear and undo/redo. Filters 10k+ rows and all facets in one pass.

props.name: fields
props.description: Filterable fields: id, label, type (enum/text/number/date/boolean), icon, options, accessor

props.name: value / onChange
props.description: Controlled filters; useUrlFilters(key) returns a URL-backed pair

props.name: options
props.description: Enum options per field id (useFilteredRows derives them from data)

props.name: facets
props.description: Live counts per enum value, computed against all other filters

props.name: views / defaultViews / onViewsChange
props.description: Saved views, controlled or uncontrolled; locked views cannot be deleted

props.name: hotkeys
props.description: F opens the typeahead; Mod+Z and Mod+Shift+Z undo and redo

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls at the right end

props.name: useFilteredRows(rows, fields, filters)
props.description: Client-side filtering plus facet counts in a single deferred pass
